title:
UiSdlMapbox type provides access to UiSdlMapbox configuration settings defined in {@link UiSdlMapboxConfig} type.

The recommended usage pattern is shown below:
* Getting the UiSdlMapbox instance:
  ```
  var mapbox = UiSdlMapbox.inst();
* Setting the UiSdlMapbox access token:
  ```
  mapbox.setAccessToken('access_token');
  ```
* Getting the UiSdlMapbox access token:
  ```
  const accessToken = mapbox.getAccessToken();
  ```
* Resetting the UiSdlMapbox access token:
  ```
  mapbox.resetAccessToken();
  ```
